page_title: ARS 1-0 NEW | Arsenal v Newcastle 18/05/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' That's it for today, Simon Hooper has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+8' Dan Burn (Newcastle Utd) receives a harsh yellow card from the referee after committing a minor foul on his opponent.
90+8' Jakub Kiwior (Arsenal) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
90+7' Newcastle fail to threaten from the corner kick as the opposition's goalkeeper plucks the ball out of the air.
90+7' The attendance is 60160.
90+7' Joe Willock (Newcastle Utd) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
90+4' David Raya (Arsenal) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
90+4' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Simon Hooper had an easy-decision to make.
90+3' Joe Willock (Newcastle Utd) argues strongly with the referee and is awarded a yellow card. A needless yellow card!
90+3' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jorginho (Arsenal) comes onto the pitch for Martin Odegaard.
90+2' The Newcastle players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
90+1' Declan Rice (Arsenal) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' A nice individual effort by Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) comes to nothing as his shot is blocked on the edge of the box by a defender.
90' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Simon Hooper no option but to blow his whistle.
88' The referee allows time for a substitution. Leandro Trossard will be replaced by Kieran Tierney (Arsenal).
88' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
85' Great teamplay by Newcastle as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
83' Joe Willock (Newcastle Utd) skips past the defender inside the box and blasts the ball at goal, but sends the effort high over the bar.
81' Mikel Arteta appears to have said too much and referee Simon Hooper comes over and theatrically shows him a yellow card.
81' Let's have a look at statistics for the fouls committed by both teams – 6:7.
78' Fabian Schar (Newcastle Utd) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
78' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Simon Hooper signals. Newcastle are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
76' Eddie Howe has decided to substitute Harvey Barnes and he is replaced by Joe Willock (Newcastle Utd).
76' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Bukayo Saka leaves the pitch and Kai Havertz (Arsenal) comes on.

75' Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) makes some space for himself and from mid-range let's fly with a wild effort which goes high over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Arsenal will have a goal kick.
75' Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
74' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
73' Simon Hooper blows his whistle as Jakub Kiwior (Arsenal) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.

70' The Newcastle players are exchanging fine passes and are waiting for an opportunity to start an attack, but here's a mistake and a loss of possession. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Arsenal.
70' Ben White (Arsenal) makes a yard for himself and attempts to endanger the goalkeeper with a long-range shot. His great effort, however, goes a whisker wide of the left post.
69' The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 4:5.
66' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Newcastle.
64' Emil Krafth (Newcastle Utd) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
64' Eddie Howe has decided to make a change. Emil Krafth (Newcastle Utd) replaces Sven Botman.
64' The game has come to an end for Callum Wilson. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of William Osula (Newcastle Utd).
63' Here is a change. Jacob Murphy is going off and Eddie Howe gives the last tactical orders to Lewis Miley (Newcastle Utd).
63' Simon Hooper blows his whistle and it's Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
63' Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
62' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.

61' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) accelerated away from the defence and took his shot early from the edge of the box. The ball flew towards the bottom right corner, but Nick Pope made a superb athletic save to deny him.
59' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) weaves his way through opponents and strikes the ball from the edge of the area, but it's blocked by a defender.
58' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
55' 1 - 0 What an absolute cracking goal! Declan Rice (Arsenal) hits a perfect volley from far out and the ball flies inside the left post. Take a bow.
54' The ratio of the ball possession is 63:37.
51' The resulting corner from Declan Rice (Arsenal) is cleared.
51' Myles Lewis-Skelly (Arsenal) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a precise pass. He pulls the trigger but only hits one of the opposition, who gets in the way of his effort.
48' Some patient build-up play from Arsenal as they look to unlock the defence.
47' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
47' Arsenal are passing the ball across the pitch and keep possession. However, an opponent intercepts a pass and the situation changes.
46' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Riccardo Calafiori (Arsenal) is coming onto the pitch as William Saliba cannot continue after picking up an injury.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
43' Myles Lewis-Skelly (Arsenal) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
40' Newcastle enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
38' 7:4 – the corner kicks stats.
36' Jakub Kiwior (Arsenal) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
36' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
33' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) takes it short.
32' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Bukayo Saka (Arsenal), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
32' Nick Pope leaps to intercept the corner kick from Bukayo Saka (Arsenal).
31' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Bukayo Saka (Arsenal).
31' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
30' Newcastle spell of possession comes to an end after a mistake.
28' Declan Rice (Arsenal) gets a shot from distance but fails to generate enough power to beat the goalkeeper.
27' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
26' The percentage of ball possession is – 62:38.
23' The Arsenal players are exchanging some short passes.
22' Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.

20' A lofted cross from Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Newcastle.
18' The resulting corner from Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
17' Dan Burn (Newcastle Utd) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the resulting corner, but he sends his header straight at the goalkeeper.
17' Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.

16' A great solo effort from Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) and he attempts to surprise the goalkeeper with a long-range shot towards the bottom right corner. David Raya has a clear view of it and makes a comfortable save.
15' Arsenal work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

14' A cross following the corner kick finds its way to Thomas Partey (Arsenal) inside the box and he manages to steer it to the top right corner. He is about to start celebrating a goal, but Nick Pope makes a save in the nick of time and maintains the current score.
14' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) steps up to send the ball in.
13' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) creates a good chance for himself and goes for goal from mid-range, but he misses the right post by a whisker.
12' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.

11' David Raya pulls off a great save to deny Valentino Livramento (Newcastle Utd) after receiving a precise defence-splitting pass. The effort is headed for the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper dives superbly to stop it. Definitely the best save of this match so far!
11' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball.

8' Newcastle players are playing combination football and attempting to create a goal-scoring opportunity, but they will have to wait for that as they have just lost possession due to a poor pass. The linesman signals a throw-in for Arsenal.

6' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) makes a yard for himself as he picks up the rebound after chaos in the box and quickly sends a shot towards the right post. The goalkeeper pulls off a remarkable save to keep the ball out. What a save!
5' Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) sends a long through ball to Callum Wilson, but he fails to control it properly and loses it to one of the defending players.
4' Ben White (Arsenal) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
3' Arsenal are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
1' Arsenal seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
1' The first half has started.
